revised_prompts: Photorealistic fixed safety-inspection camera frame, 1920x1080 landscape. Camera mounted about 1.5 meters above floor, observing a narrow service hallway with utility doors, exposed pipes, and a matte concrete floor with partial shadow from nearby structure. Right-oblique view at medium distance, natural perspective, realistic scale, enough surrounding context to judge body support. A young adult with a medium build wearing a light work shirt and dark cargo trousers, brown and cream clothing tones, is in a stable kneeling pose facing slightly away from the camera; clearly visible and not spread horizontally on the floor. Include a column or partition partly framing one side of the image. Ordinary photographic detail, restrained contrast, unedited inspection-camera capture, clear subject detail, no cinematic or advertising look. No text, captions, watermarks, logos, labels, overlays, bounding boxes, arrows, circles, or artificial annotations.
